cases.description: Top-level and nested object keys sorted; values untouched
Arrays keep semantic order (never sorted); deep nesting sorted at every object level
BMP unicode in keys and values serialized as raw UTF-8, no escaping
Empty objects/arrays preserved at every nesting level
undefined normalizes to null (JSON has no undefined; Python adapters skip)
Astral-plane keys sort in UTF-16 code-unit order per the pinned KEY_ORDER_UTF16 semantic (z < U+1F600 < U+E000). Python code-point sort diverges here: recorded FAIL.
Finite float must be refused (pinned FLOATS_REFUSED)
Float nested inside object/array must be refused
NaN must be refused, never null-swallowed or literal-serialized

meta.applies: ts = TypeScript/JavaScript adapters, py = Python adapters

input_markers.$float: revived to NaN | Infinity | -Infinity before the call
input_markers.$undefined: revived to undefined before the call (TS adapters only)

meta.name: canonical-bytes cross-language conformance fixture

pinned_semantics.BYTE_FORM: Recursive key sort, array order preserved (semantic, never sorted), separators (',',':'), raw UTF-8 (no \uXXXX escaping), undefined -> null, empty structures preserved.
pinned_semantics.FLOATS_REFUSED: Any float value (finite or non-finite) in the input must make the canonicalizer throw/refuse, never emit bytes. Rationale: Python and JS serialize floats differently (repr vs shortest round-trip, integer-valued floats, exponent formatting), so a digest must never silently depend on it. dump.py already refuses; the pin extends fail-closed behavior to all sides.
pinned_semantics.KEY_ORDER_UTF16: Object keys sort in UTF-16 code-unit order (JS String sort, i.e. the reference Object.keys().sort()). Python sorted() uses code-point order and diverges on astral-plane keys; that divergence is a recorded FAIL, not an accepted variant.

meta.scope: canonical BYTES only. The hashCanonical envelope (canonical_version, serialization_version, algorithm) is a TS-jurisdiction versioning construct and is out of scope for cross-language digest conformance.
